faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions we receive
faq.q1: How can I book an appointment?
faq.a1: You can contact us by phone at +30 2310 545 261, by email at iopapaio@gmail.com, or by filling out the contact form on the website. We will respond within 24 hours to schedule a meeting.
faq.q2: What areas of law do you specialize in?
faq.a2: Our primary specialisations are Banking Law & Objections and the Out-of-Court Debt Settlement Mechanism. We also handle Criminal, Commercial, Real Estate, Administrative, Inheritance, Tax and Labor Law matters. You can see all areas in detail on the «Practice Areas» page.
faq.q3: Do you handle cases outside Thessaloniki?
faq.a3: Yes, we handle cases throughout Greece. For cases outside Thessaloniki, collaboration with a local lawyer or additional travel expenses may be required, agreed upon in advance.
faq.q4: How long does it take to resolve a case?
faq.a4: The duration depends on the type of case, jurisdiction and court schedules. At our first meeting we will provide a realistic time estimate based on our experience with similar cases.
faq.q5: Is the information I share confidential?
faq.a5: Absolutely. We are bound by professional confidentiality as provided by the Greek Code of Lawyers. Any information you share with us — whether in meetings, by email or by phone — remains strictly confidential.
faq.q6: Can I contact you by email for updates?
faq.a6: Of course. We provide continuous updates on the progress of your case via email, phone or in-person meetings, according to your preferences.

banking.title: Banking Law & Objections
banking.desc: Objections, enforcement, suspension of auctions and defence of borrowers.
banking.longDesc: Banking Law is the firm's primary area of expertise. We handle a wide range of cases concerning the borrower–bank relationship, with a focus on timely and effective defence against claims by banking institutions and loan management companies (funds). Our experience covers objections to payment orders, enforcement objections, suspension and annulment of auctions, as well as offensive claims against banks for abusive terms.
banking.approach: We do not treat a payment order, seizure or auction as a fait accompli. Every file is examined from the ground up: the claim itself, its transfer, standing, interest, charges, enforcement acts and every avenue of defence or attack. The goal is to shift the balance of power before the borrower is pressured into signing under duress or loses assets without any real scrutiny.
services: Objection against payment order
Enforcement objection and opposition to enforcement actions
Suspension and annulment of residential or commercial property auction
Claims against banks for abusive contractual terms
Fund cases — management of claims by companies such as Dovalue, Cepal etc.
Application for exemption of primary residence from auction

extrajudicial.title: Out-of-Court Mechanism & Negotiations
extrajudicial.desc: Out-of-Court Debt Settlement Mechanism (Law 4738/2020), bilateral negotiations and debt restructuring.
extrajudicial.longDesc: Out-of-court debt settlement is often the fastest and most cost-effective solution for individuals and businesses facing serious financial difficulties. We have extensive experience in the Out-of-Court Debt Settlement Mechanism under Law 4738/2020 as well as in direct (bilateral) negotiations with banks, funds and other creditors.
extrajudicial.approach: Negotiation with funds and loan management companies must never begin from a position of fear. Before any settlement proposal is considered, we examine the claim itself, the outstanding amount, standing, payments made, interest and the full consequences of any agreement. A restructuring is only a solution when it genuinely protects the debtor — not when it amounts to uncritical acceptance of a claim that has never been properly scrutinised.
services: Application for the Out-of-Court Debt Settlement Mechanism (Law 4738/2020)
Negotiation of debt restructuring with banks, the State and insurance funds
Bilateral negotiations with banks and loan management companies
Bankruptcy application and reorganisation plan (New Insolvency Code)
Over-indebted household debt settlement
Strategy planning for repayment and asset protection

criminal.desc: Defence in criminal cases at all levels, in collaboration with specialist attorneys.

The firm handles criminal cases in collaboration with experienced associate criminal lawyers, ensuring the best possible local and subject-matter representation.
criminal.approach: We meticulously study the case file, identify procedural gaps and build the defence strategy that best serves our client, in close collaboration with specialists in criminal law.
services: Defence of defendants at all stages of preliminary and main proceedings
Representation of victims as civil claimants
Appeals and cassation
Financial crimes and press offences
Cases against life, bodily integrity and property

commercial.longDesc: Businesses operate in a complex legal environment that requires constant attention. We provide comprehensive legal support to businesses of all sizes, from incorporation and organization to contract management and resolution of commercial disputes.
commercial.approach: We combine legal expertise with an understanding of business needs, so that the solutions we propose are not only legally sound but also practically applicable.

realEstate.desc: Property transactions, leases and land registry matters.
realEstate.longDesc: Buying or selling property is one of the most important financial decisions in a person's life. A thorough legal review of titles and proper drafting of contracts are essential to avoid future problems.
realEstate.approach: We perform a full title check at the land registry and cadastre, monitor the entire process through to registration and ensure that our client is fully protected.

labor.longDesc: Labor disputes require swift and effective handling, as they concern people's livelihood. We represent both employees and employers in collaboration with specialist labor law attorneys, aiming to fully protect their legitimate interests.
labor.approach: We first seek out-of-court resolution through the Labor Inspectorate, and where this is not possible, we prepare the court claim with specialist associates and all necessary evidence.

administrative.approach: We carefully examine every administrative act for legality and constitutionality, and use all available legal remedies to defend our client's rights, in close collaboration with specialists in the field.

about.title: Our Firm
about.name: Ioannis Papaioannou
about.bio1: With more than 25 years of experience, we represent individuals and businesses across a wide range of legal matters. Our philosophy is built on client dedication, transparency and achieving the best possible outcomes.
about.bio2: We approach every case with full commitment, combining in-depth knowledge of the law with a practical approach to problem solving.

about.edu2: LL.M. Postgraduate Studies, Ludwig Maximilian University of Munich
about.teaserSub: Over 25 years of experience at your service.
about.value1Desc: Strict adherence to professional ethics in every case we handle.
about.value2Desc: Personal communication and immediate updates on every development.
about.value3Desc: Continuous professional training and close monitoring of case law.
bioParagraphs: Ioannis Papaioannou is an Attorney at the Supreme Court of Greece (Areios Pagos), with extensive courtroom experience in civil, commercial and banking law. He has maintained a law office in Thessaloniki since 2000, handling cases of significant legal and economic importance for individuals, professionals and businesses.

Born in Preveza and raised in Munich, he holds a law degree from the Democritus University of Thrace and an LL.M. from Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität München. His legal career combines Greek courtroom practice with a German legal education — a combination that shapes his approach to complex cases: precise, methodical and strategically minded.

In recent years he has concentrated a significant part of his practice on banking law cases, enforcement proceedings, foreclosure auctions, objections against payment orders and disputes with funds and debt management companies. His practice is not limited to passive defence of the borrower, but includes a full review of the claim, its legitimacy, the enforcement acts, interest charges, fees and the chain of debt transfer.

Particular emphasis is placed on protecting the home and assets of debtors facing payment orders, seizures and foreclosure auctions. His approach combines judicial defence with substantive negotiation — aiming not merely at temporary relief from pressure, but at a genuine strategic solution.

He also heads the legal team of the Association of Borrowers and Consumer Protection of Northern Greece, actively supporting borrowers and consumers facing over-indebtedness, bank claims and enforcement proceedings. This role reflects his consistent engagement with debtor protection issues and his conviction that legal support against banks, funds and debt management companies must be immediate, well-documented and assertive.

His legal philosophy is built on careful study of each case file, timely use of procedural options and a realistic but determined approach. Every payment order, every seizure and every foreclosure auction is treated not as a fait accompli, but as an act that must be rigorously examined — legally and factually.

The office's goal is to provide substantive legal protection, with clarity, honesty and a focus on results. Every case begins with a full assessment of the facts, documents, deadlines and options for defence or negotiation, so that the client knows from the outset what their actual position is and what steps need to be taken.

intrum.seoDescription: Being pressured by Intrum with notices, a payment order or a foreclosure? Every document has a defence deadline. Objection, suspension, haircut settlement in Thessaloniki. Tel: +30 2310 545 261.
intrum.heroTitle: Lawyer for Intrum Foreclosures in Thessaloniki
intrum.intro: Letters from Intrum are not informational — they are the prelude to legal action. A formal notice, payment order, enforcement order or auction schedule: each document opens a deadline that, once missed, never comes back. Our office faces servicers in the courts of Thessaloniki on a daily basis. Ioannis Papaioannou, legal counsel to the Borrowers' & Consumer Protection Association of Northern Greece, has fought alongside borrowers for over 25 years — and knows first-hand how a defence is built and how a favourable settlement with Intrum is closed.
intrum.whatTitle: What is Intrum and what it means for your loan
intrum.whatText: Intrum Hellas is one of the largest loan servicing companies in the country — it primarily manages portfolios originating from Piraeus Bank, on behalf of international investment funds. Keep two things in mind. First: Intrum is not the "owner" of your loan — it acts as a servicer, and its authority to act must be validly proven at every step. Second: the loans in these portfolios were acquired at a price far below their book balance. Intrum knows this when it negotiates. So should you.
intrum.protectTitle: Protecting Your Primary Residence from an Intrum Foreclosure
intrum.protectText: No home is lost because of a letter — it is lost through inaction in the face of one. From the first demand to the posting of an auction schedule, the law provides specific means of defence: objection, suspension application, the out-of-court workout, a sustainable settlement. In every file we take on, we review from zero: who actually has standing, whether the amount is correctly calculated, whether the procedure was followed. That is where cases are won — in the details servicers hope nobody will examine.
intrum.deadlinesTitle: Received a Notice or Payment Order from Intrum: The Critical Deadlines
intrum.deadlinesIntro: Defence deadlines are preclusive: once they pass, the right is extinguished — no matter how strong your arguments were.

deadlines.title: Payment Order — 15 working days
deadlines.desc: An objection against a payment order must be filed within 15 working days of service. Without one, Intrum obtains an enforceable title — and the road to seizure opens.

deadlines.title: Seizure — 45 days
deadlines.desc: An objection against enforcement carries a 45-day deadline from the seizure. At this stage, standing, the debt calculation and procedural defects are all challenged.

deadlines.title: Before the Auction — the final 15 days
deadlines.desc: Even with an auction date set, a narrow window remains for a suspension application. Every earlier day counts — but even at the last moment we examine every available remedy.

intrum.deadlinesWarning: Do not leave Intrum's document in a drawer "for later". The service date is already counting down — bring it in for review today.
intrum.cta1Title: Holding an Intrum document right now?
intrum.cta1Text: Immediate first assessment: what was served, which deadline is running, which moves are available. Call +30 2310 545 261 or send the form.
intrum.negotiationTitle: Negotiation Strategy: How We Achieve a Sustainable Debt Haircut with Intrum
intrum.negotiationIntro: You do not approach Intrum to ask for a favour — you approach it to present a position. Whichever side knows the file better dictates the terms. We make sure that side is you:
negotiationPoints: Full review before any contact: Intrum's standing, the real balance, unlawful interest and charges. An unverified amount is not up for discussion.
The claim's real acquisition value as the baseline: the portfolio was bought at a fraction of the balance — our proposal stands on that, not on the number in the letter.
A settlement that survives over time: matched to your real income and the property's objective value, so it does not collapse at the second instalment.
Judicial leverage where needed: a well-founded pending objection turns an "immovable" servicer into a willing counterpart.
intrum.negotiationOutro: A haircut is not an act of goodwill by Intrum — it is the product of properly built pressure. Legal and negotiating.
intrum.cta2Title: Before you reply to or sign anything for Intrum — talk to us.
intrum.cta2Text: One hasty acknowledgement of debt can close doors that are open today. Review first, reply second.
intrum.anakopiTitle: Objection and Suspension of Foreclosure in the Courts of Thessaloniki
intrum.anakopiText1: We work where these cases are decided: the Magistrates' Court and the Court of First Instance of Thessaloniki, daily. Knowledge of local case law and practice is not CV decoration — it is what turns an objection from a formality into a real defence. The grounds that most often succeed against servicers like Intrum:
anakopiPoints: Standing deficiencies: the chain of transfer of the claim or the servicing assignment is not fully and validly proven.
Incorrect debt amount: unlawful compound interest, abusive charges, sums not owed.
Abusive contract terms undermining the claim at its core.
Procedural defects: defective service, errors in the seizure report, missed deadlines.
intrum.anakopiText2: Where the case requires it, the objection is paired with a suspension application, keeping the auction on ice until the merits are decided. That wins both time and negotiating weight.

faq.q: Intrum keeps calling me. What should I do?
faq.a: Do not commit to anything verbally and do not "acknowledge" the debt on the phone. Ask for everything in writing, keep a log of calls and documents, and bring the file in for review before any reply.

faq.q: Can Intrum auction my property?
faq.a: Only with an enforceable title and a fully valid procedure — both are subject to judicial review. The servicer's standing, the claim amount and every enforcement act have points of challenge with specific deadlines.

faq.q: Is it worth negotiating with Intrum on my own?
faq.a: It is risky. You are facing a specialised operation that negotiates thousands of cases — you have one. Without a file review you don't even know whether the amount demanded is correct, or what your real bargaining power is.

faq.q: The auction is very close. Is there still hope?
faq.a: It depends on the file — but the answer only comes after we see it, and quickly. Procedural defects may support action even in the final days. Call +30 2310 545 261 immediately.

faq.q: What documents do you need for the review?
faq.a: Everything received from Intrum or, before it, from the bank: letters, notices, payment order, enforcement order, seizure report, auction schedule and the loan agreement. Most important of all: the service dates.

intrum.ctaTitle: Intrum negotiates every day. We litigate every day.
intrum.ctaText: Office at 12 Leontos Sofou St., Thessaloniki. Due to strict deadlines, your file is assessed urgently — today, not "at some point".

dovalue.seoDescription: Received a payment order or foreclosure notice from doValue Greece? Deadlines are running. Objection, suspension, debt haircut negotiation in Thessaloniki. Call: +30 2310 545 261.
dovalue.heroTitle: Lawyer for doValue Foreclosures in Thessaloniki
dovalue.intro: If you are holding a document signed by doValue Greece — a formal notice, payment order, enforcement order or foreclosure schedule — your time is measured in days, not months. Our office handles cases against servicers and funds daily in the courts of Thessaloniki. Ioannis Papaioannou, legal counsel to the Borrowers' & Consumer Protection Association of Northern Greece, has defended borrowers against banks and loan servicers for over 25 years. We know how doValue operates, where it pushes — and where it backs down.
dovalue.whatTitle: What is doValue and why is it contacting you
dovalue.whatText: doValue Greece is the largest loan servicing company in Greece. It is not a bank: it manages loans that banks transferred to international funds — usually for a fraction of what you are being asked to pay today. This has two practical consequences. First, doValue acts on behalf of a third party, and its legal standing in every individual act is subject to judicial review — which does not always come out in its favour. Second, when a claim was bought at a fraction of its face value, there is real, proven room for a haircut. Anyone negotiating without knowing this is negotiating blind.
dovalue.protectTitle: Protecting Your Primary Residence from a doValue Foreclosure
dovalue.protectText: A home is not lost when a notice arrives. It is lost when the legal deadlines pass unused. At every stage — from the first demand letter to days before the auction — specific legal tools exist: objection, suspension application, the out-of-court workout, settlement. We treat no foreclosure as final. Every file is reviewed from scratch: doValue's standing, the accuracy of the claim, abusive terms, procedural defects. That is where the outcome is decided.
dovalue.deadlinesTitle: Received a Notice or Payment Order from doValue: The Critical Deadlines
dovalue.deadlinesIntro: Every served document triggers a strict statutory deadline. Once it passes, the right is lost permanently — however well-founded your objections were.

deadlines.title: Payment Order — 15 working days
deadlines.desc: From service of a payment order you have 15 working days to file an objection. If none is filed, the order becomes an enforceable title: doValue's next step is seizure.

deadlines.title: Seizure — 45 days
deadlines.desc: From the imposition of seizure, a 45-day deadline runs for an objection against enforcement. This is where the fund's standing, the amount of the claim and every procedural defect are challenged.

deadlines.title: Before the Auction — the final 15 days
deadlines.desc: Even after an auction has been scheduled, a narrow window exists for a suspension application. The earlier you act, the more tools we have — but even in the final days not everything is lost.

dovalue.deadlinesWarning: The service date on your document is not a detail — it is the clock counting down. Bring us the document today, not tomorrow.
dovalue.cta1Title: Holding a doValue document right now?
dovalue.cta1Text: Your file gets an immediate first assessment: what exactly was served, which deadline is running, what options you have. Call +30 2310 545 261 or fill in the form.
dovalue.negotiationTitle: Negotiation Strategy: How We Achieve a Sustainable Debt Haircut with doValue
dovalue.negotiationIntro: Negotiating with doValue is not pleading — it is a contest of positions. The outcome depends on who knows the file better. Our job is to shift that balance in your favour:
negotiationPoints: File review before any contact: standing, the real amount owed, unlawful charges and interest. We do not negotiate a figure we have not verified.
Leveraging the claim's real value: the fund bought your loan at a fraction of the balance. Our proposal is built on that fact — not on the figure printed in the letter.
A sustainable proposal, not wishful thinking: based on your actual financial capacity and the property's objective value. Proposals that don't add up get rejected — ours add up.
Judicial pressure where needed: a pending objection with well-founded grounds radically changes the other side's willingness to settle.
dovalue.negotiationOutro: A haircut is not given — it is won. And it is won by those who come to the table with a complete file and a credible judicial threat.
dovalue.cta2Title: Before you reply to or sign anything for doValue — talk to us.
dovalue.cta2Text: One wrong signature can acknowledge a debt that could have been contested. Review first, reply second.
dovalue.anakopiTitle: Objection and Suspension of Foreclosure in the Courts of Thessaloniki
dovalue.anakopiText1: Our cases are heard where we work every day: the Magistrates' Court and the Court of First Instance of Thessaloniki. Experience in these specific courts — their case law, their practice — is what separates an objection that was merely filed from an objection that was won. The grounds that most often succeed against servicers:
anakopiPoints: Standing defects: the transfer of the claim or the servicing assignment is not fully and validly proven.
Miscalculated debt: unlawful compound interest, abusive charges, levies not owed.
Abusive terms in the loan agreement undermining the validity of the claim.
Procedural defects in enforcement: defective service, errors in the seizure report, missed statutory deadlines.
dovalue.anakopiText2: Where needed, the objection is combined with a suspension application — freezing the auction until the merits are decided. The goal is twofold: win time and build negotiating leverage.

faq.q: I've been getting calls and letters from doValue. Should I respond?
faq.a: Not before your file is reviewed. Any verbal or written acknowledgement of the debt can weaken defences you currently have. Log the communications, keep the documents, and get legal review before committing to anything.

faq.q: Can doValue auction my home?
faq.a: Only if it holds an enforceable title and the procedure is valid at every step — and that is precisely what courts review. Standing, claim amount, enforcement acts: every stage has checkpoints and defence deadlines.

faq.q: How much of a haircut can I realistically achieve?
faq.a: It depends on the portfolio, the collateral, your financial profile and the judicial pressure that can be applied. On secured loans, settlements with substantial write-offs are entirely achievable when negotiation is backed by a complete file — not by pleading.

faq.q: The auction is days away. Is there still time?
faq.a: Possibly — but every hour counts. Even in the final days options may exist, depending on the procedure's defects. Call +30 2310 545 261 immediately with the auction schedule in front of you.

faq.q: What should I bring to the first appointment?
faq.a: Every document you have received: notices, payment order, enforcement order, seizure report, auction schedule, and the loan agreement if you have it. And the service dates — all deadlines are counted from them.

funds.intro: The transfer of your loan to an NPL fund does not mean a dead end. Thousands of borrowers in Greece now face companies such as DoValue, Intrum or Cepal as their new creditors — without knowing their rights. With specialised expertise in banking law and NPL markets, we assess every case from the start: legality of transfer, claim amount, grounds for challenge, and negotiation strategy.
funds.whatText: NPL funds (non-performing loan funds or credit servicers) purchased large portfolios of non-performing loans from Greek banks under Law 4354/2015. These transfers must meet strict legal requirements — and often do not. A fund is not a bank: it has different obligations, different limitations, and different legal vulnerabilities.

faq.q: Can a fund foreclose on my home?
faq.a: Yes, provided the transfer was lawful and the claim is enforceable. However, loan portfolio transfers raise serious legal issues — standing, completeness of the claim, accuracy of the principal amount — that can be effectively challenged. Every case is reviewed individually.

faq.q: What is the difference between a fund and a bank for the borrower?
faq.a: A fund does not hold a banking licence and operates under a different legal regime. Notification obligations, charge limits, and standing requirements differ significantly from those of a bank — and these differences can form the basis for a legal challenge.

faq.q: Can I negotiate with a fund without a lawyer?
faq.a: Technically yes, but it is not recommended. Funds employ specialist negotiators who know exactly where you stand. Without a review of the claim, you risk signing a settlement for an amount you do not owe, or on terms that do not serve your interests.

faq.q: What should I do if I just received a notice of loan transfer to a fund?
faq.a: Do not ignore the notice, but do not sign anything without legal review. Request a full detailed statement of the outstanding amount immediately and consult a specialist lawyer to assess the legality of the transfer and the accuracy of the claim.

pleistariasmos.seoDescription: Facing foreclosure on your primary residence? There are legal options. Injunctions, stays, seizure cancellations. 25+ years' experience in Thessaloniki.
pleistariasmos.heroTitle: Primary Residence Foreclosure: Legal Options You May Not Know
pleistariasmos.intro: Foreclosure of your primary residence is not inevitable. Greek law provides significant rights of defence — provided you act in time. With 25+ years of banking and enforcement law experience, we have helped hundreds of debtors protect their homes from banks and funds.
pleistariasmos.whatText: A forced auction (πλειστηριασμός) is the compulsory sale of a property or assets to satisfy a creditor — bank, fund, or the State. Greek law provides significant rights of defence for the debtor, provided you act in time.

pleistariasmos.optionsTitle: What You Can Do — 4 Legal Options

options.title: Application for Auction Stay
options.desc: The court can issue a temporary stay order even days before the auction. The application must demonstrate probable harm and legal grounds — we identify these for you.

options.title: Filing under Law 4738/2020
options.desc: The New Insolvency Code allows individuals who meet the criteria to restructure their debts and protect their primary residence. Filing automatically suspends all enforcement proceedings.

options.title: Objection to Enforcement
options.desc: An objection to enforcement (Article 933 CCP) challenges the legality of the seizure or auction on formal or substantive grounds — including the validity of the fund's claim.

options.title: Negotiation with Bank or Fund
options.desc: Negotiating before the auction is often the fastest solution. We assess the claim first — only then do we know from what position we are negotiating.

pleistariasmos.ctaInlineTitle: Not sure which option applies to your case?
pleistariasmos.ctaInlineText: Every case is different. Contact us for a full assessment of your legal position and available options.

timelineItems.title: Maximum options — ideal timing
timelineItems.desc: There is time for an objection, stay application, filing under Law 4738/2020, and negotiation from a position of strength. All options remain open.

timelineItems.title: Urgent — still achievable
timelineItems.desc: A stay application must be filed immediately. The court can grant a temporary order. Every day of delay reduces the odds.

timelineItems.title: There is still a way out
timelineItems.desc: An objection to the sale, an unjust enrichment claim, and a challenge to the legality of the claim assignment remain possible. Do not give up without legal advice.

faq.q: Can an auction be stayed just days before it takes place?
faq.a: Yes, in many cases this is possible if there are valid legal grounds and the application is filed in time. The court can issue a temporary stay order even the day before the auction.

faq.q: What is an objection to enforcement?
faq.a: An objection to enforcement (Article 933 CCP) is the main judicial remedy to challenge the legality of a seizure or auction. It can be based on formal or substantive defects in the enforcement process.

faq.q: Can a fund auction my home?
faq.a: Yes, if the claim has been validly assigned to it. However, the assignment of claims from banks to funds raises significant legal questions that can be effectively challenged in court.

cepal.seoDescription: Received a payment order or enforcement notice from Cepal? Every document triggers strict deadlines for legal defence. Objection, suspension, debt settlement in Thessaloniki. Tel: 2310 545 261.
cepal.heroTitle: Lawyer for Cepal Auctions and Enforcement in Thessaloniki
cepal.intro: Documents from Cepal are not mere reminders — they start legal processes with firm deadlines. Payment order, seizure, auction programme: each document opens a window for action that closes permanently once the deadline passes. Our office handles servicer cases at the Thessaloniki courts on a daily basis. Ioannis Papaioannou, Legal Adviser to the Association of Borrowers and Consumer Protection of Northern Greece, knows how Cepal operates — and how to build an effective defence.
cepal.whatTitle: What Is Cepal and What Does It Mean for Your Loan?
cepal.whatText: Cepal Hellas Financial Services is the largest servicer in Greece by managed portfolio, primarily handling loans from Eurobank (Cairo securitisation programme) and other Greek banks. Two key points: first, Cepal is a manager, not the owner of your loan — it must prove its authority to act on the fund's behalf at every step. Second, these portfolios were acquired at a fraction of face value. That acquisition price is the foundation of any realistic settlement negotiation.
cepal.protectTitle: Protecting Your Primary Residence from Cepal Auction
cepal.protectText: Because of its large portfolio volume, Cepal moves quickly — and that speed creates procedural vulnerabilities. We check every file from the start: whether authority is properly established, whether the debt amount is correctly calculated, whether every service of process and enforcement act complies strictly with Greek law. High volume often means rushed procedures — and rushed procedures create grounds for challenge.
cepal.deadlinesTitle: Received a Payment Order or Notice from Cepal? Critical Deadlines
cepal.deadlinesIntro: Greek procedural law grants no extensions on deadlines for challenging servicers. Once a deadline passes, the enforcement title becomes unassailable and the path to seizure opens unobstructed.

deadlines.title: Payment Order — 15 working days
deadlines.desc: An objection must be filed within 15 working days of service. After that, Cepal holds an enforceable title and can proceed to property seizure.

deadlines.title: Seizure — 45 days
deadlines.desc: The objection against enforcement must be filed within 45 days of seizure. At this stage, the authority chain, the debt amount, and procedural defects can all be challenged.

deadlines.title: Before Auction — last 15 days
deadlines.desc: Even with an auction date set, an application for suspension of enforcement remains possible. Every day earlier improves the chances — but we examine every available option even at the last moment.

cepal.deadlinesWarning: The clock started the day Cepal served the document. Do not wait for a convenient moment — bring the file for review today.
cepal.cta1Title: Do you have a Cepal document in front of you?
cepal.cta1Text: Immediate first review: what was served, which deadline is running, what options you have. Call 2310 545 261 or send the contact form.
cepal.negotiationTitle: Negotiation Strategy: Achieving a Viable Debt Settlement with Cepal
cepal.negotiationIntro: Cepal manages portfolios acquired at a discount — we use this as a practical tool in negotiation, not just a theoretical point. How we build your position:
negotiationPoints: Full file review before any contact: authority chain, actual balance, interest charges and fees that may be disputed. We do not negotiate without knowing exactly what claim we are dealing with.
Acquisition cost as the starting point for any proposal: the portfolio was purchased at a fraction of face value — our offer is based on economic reality, not the figure in the letter.
Settlement tailored to real repayment capacity: the goal is an agreement that holds, not an instalment that collapses in six months.
Court proceedings as a negotiating lever: a pending objection changes the dynamic — Cepal recognises it is dealing with a legally represented counterparty, not an uninformed debtor.
cepal.negotiationOutro: The goal is not the best possible deal under pressure — it is the settlement that fits the specific file, with specific numbers and a specific strategy.
cepal.cta2Title: Before signing anything with Cepal — speak to us first.
cepal.cta2Text: A rushed settlement can be worse than signing nothing. We review first, then decide.
cepal.anakopiTitle: Objection and Suspension of Cepal Auctions in Thessaloniki
cepal.anakopiText1: Cepal's high case volume makes it particularly exposed to procedural defects. Grounds that typically support objections and suspensions in Cepal cases:
anakopiPoints: Weak authority chain: securitisation and management assignment involve multiple transfer steps that must each be properly documented — gaps here are a significant basis for objection.
Incorrect debt amount: unlawful compound interest, abusive fees, miscalculated default interest.
Unfair contractual terms: clauses that were not individually negotiated and that undermine the legal foundation of the claim.
Formal enforcement defects: irregular service of process, incorrect amounts in the seizure report, failure to observe mandatory intervals.
cepal.anakopiText2: Where the case requires it, an objection is accompanied by an immediate suspension application so that the auction is stayed until a court decision is issued. This combination — legal defence and parallel negotiation — is usually the most effective approach.

faq.q: Cepal is asking me to sign an out-of-court settlement. Should I?
faq.a: Do not sign anything without legal review. An out-of-court agreement may block defences you currently have — objection, debt challenge, suspension. We review it at no charge during the first consultation.

faq.q: Cepal is the biggest servicer in Greece. Can I really fight them?
faq.a: Size does not protect against legal defects — high volume actually increases the likelihood of errors in service of process, debt calculations, and authority chains. That is what we examine first.

faq.q: My loan was with Eurobank. Why is Cepal writing to me?
faq.a: Your loan was likely assigned to the Cairo securitisation programme or another SPV, with Cepal appointed as manager. That assignment must have been properly executed and notified to you — we check this as part of the file review.

faq.q: What happens if I simply do not respond to Cepal?
faq.a: Silence is not a defence. If a payment order has been issued or a seizure has taken place, inaction allows Cepal to proceed without obstacle. The earlier you have the file reviewed, the more options remain open.
